title: City-Data input
description: One city or a list. Field groups match the local city-data scraper.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Objects with city, state, and optional slug. Overrides city + state when set.

city.title: City
city.description: Single city name, used when cities is empty.

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter state code for the single-city form.

slug.title: Slug override
slug.description: Optional city-data path token for the single-city form.

fields.title: Field groups
fields.description: population, income, housing, cost_of_living, education, crime. crime fetches the crime page.

delaySeconds.title: Delay between requests (seconds)
delaySeconds.description: Pause between page loads. Default 1.5, same as the local CLI.

maxCities.title: Max cities
maxCities.description: Optional cap on how many cities from the list are scraped.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Ignored. This Actor does not rotate proxies or IPs.
